tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: DISCOVERY ONLY: search Roomza's hotel database by city, keyword, or natural language query when the user has NOT named a specific hotel. Understands hotel types (boutique, resort, luxury), vibes (romantic, trendy, quiet), traveler types (couples, families, solo), neighborhoods, and nearby landmarks.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Get full details for a hotel including: Roomza Truth summary, score breakdown, top strengths, hotel character (type, vibes, best-for), nearby landmarks with distances, neighborhood, awards, amenities, and review highlights from the open web. Use hotel name, slug, or UUID as the identifier. This is t

tools.name: get_hotel_rooms
tools.description: List rooms for a hotel with individual Roomza scores, bed type, view, and floor. Pass room_number to look up a specific room.

tools.name: get_recent_reviews
tools.description: Get verified guest reviews for a hotel, including comments and insider tips. Pass room_number to get reviews for a specific room.

tools.name: get_hotel_pricing
tools.description: Get public room rates for a hotel (the hotel's own public rate). Pass check_in and check_out dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to get nightly from-prices per room type. Without dates, returns the hotel's typical nightly from-price. No booking links; to price and book an exact room, use secure_room.

tools.name: get_nearby
tools.description: Get nearby places (restaurants, bars, attractions, parks) and upcoming events near a hotel. Optionally filter events to a travel window with start_date / end_date.

tools.name: ask_about_hotel
tools.description: Ask a specific question about a hotel that standard data may not answer. Uses AI with web search to find the answer. Examples: 'Does this hotel have Eiffel Tower views?', 'Is there a rooftop bar?', 'How far is it from the airport?'. Try get_hotel first; use this only when that data doesn't answer th

tools.name: find_matching_rooms
tools.description: Find the specific hotel rooms that fit a traveler, with the evidence behind each fact. Use this whenever the traveler cares about the room itself: bed, view, bathtub, balcony, accessibility, floor, quiet, Wi-Fi, connecting rooms, kitchenette, pets, blackout, a desk, distance from the elevator, a win

tools.name: get_room_evidence
tools.description: Every fact Roomza holds about one room or room type, each with its source (the hotel's record, guests' in-room checks, verified reviews, a supplier listing), how it was verified, and when. Use it to answer 'how do you know?' about a room from find_matching_rooms.

tools.name: show_rooms
tools.description: REQUIRED whenever you present rooms. Whenever you are about to mention, recommend, or describe one or more specific rooms to the user, you MUST call this tool with those room UUIDs INSTEAD of writing the rooms in text. This is mandatory even when there is only ONE matching room — show it as a single

tools.name: get_my_trips
tools.description: Look up your upcoming and past hotel bookings/trips on Roomza. Requires connecting your Roomza account.

tools.name: get_my_preferences
tools.description: Get your saved room preferences, standing requests, and loyalty accounts on Roomza. Requires connecting your Roomza account.

tools.name: add_special_request
tools.description: Add a special request to one of your bookings (e.g. extra pillows, late checkout, anniversary celebration). Requires connecting your Roomza account.

tools.name: secure_room
tools.description: Price and lock an exact room for specific dates. Returns the live price, cancellation policy, and a secure booking link with the room preselected. Requires connecting your Roomza account.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Where the traveler's Roomza bookings stand: confirmed or not, whether the room asked for by number is requested, confirmed by the hotel, assigned or missed, the hotel's confirmation number, the total, when the card is charged, and the free-cancellation deadline. tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the traveler's Roomza bookings, inside its free-cancellation window only, with a full refund. Call it first without confirm: it says what would happen and changes nothing. Tell the traveler, and only after they agree call it again with confirm set to true. Outside the window it refuses

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "show_rooms" stacks urgency/override words (always, never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
